# Wardens inside one Claude Code process (the project host): is this moment mine?

## What this region is

The project Warden host (the default for Claude decisions): every Warden of a project hosted as subagents inside one Foundry-owned Claude Code process, held on Foundry's moment tool and served fresh per call, open only while someone works in the project; a Warden whose host is not serving is skipped and catches up, never sent to primed sessions.

## What it exists for

- Pick where a thread's Warden calls actually run
- Get a project's Wardens started and ready
- End or replace Warden agents without waking the main model

## When this is not your domain

These mention this region's words but belong elsewhere; the answer is no, and the region named answers instead.

- decision sessions for the primed pool keep re-priming → decision-hosts
- which login and model should the Warden calls use by default → decision-hosts
- the subagent should show up as a child thread in the tree → journal-thread-tree
- which Wardens does this project's thread hold → chorus
- redirect native subagents through Foundry instead of letting them run → tool-gate-mcp
